text:
maria: Heads up — customer reported that after our deprecation banner went live some v1 clients started getting 429s. They claim routing moved them to v2 while SDK still sends `X-Client-Version: 1`. Any ideas?

 derek: Routing should prefer exact version header then fall back. We didn't change quota logic.

 maria: Example they pasted:
 ```
 POST /v1/generate
 Host: api.redwood.com
 X-Client-Version: 1
 Authorization: Bearer ...
 ```
 They said console showed migrate banner and errors spiked.

 zane: When the banner is acked do we flip routing server-side or client-side? We had an "opt-in" that set a tenant flag async.

 derek: Banner click sets tenant flag async; routing cache (30s) could cause mismatch but shouldn't produce 429s by itself.

 ira: Likely quota mapping. v2 has different cost model; if requests routed to compat proxy but were accounted under v2 quota (or vice versa) tenants could overflow.

 maria: What telemetry keys to check?

 derek: Check `route.selected` (values like `clients/v1`, `compat/v1->v2`) and `quota.accounted_as` (v1 or v2) and `quota.delta_tokens`. If you see compat/v1->v2 + quota.accounted_as:v2 that's the bug.

 zane: Also look at `console.feature_toggle` events for timing.

 ira: Proposal: make routing decision and quota accounting atomic via a snapshot id. Add `route.snapshot_id` and `quota.account_snapshot_id` to events.

 zane: UX change: make banner modal show retry guidance: "Switching now — you may see transient errors, please retry." less alarming than 429.

 derek: Rollout plan: 1) confirm mismatches, 2) instrument snapshot id, 3) change quota lookup to use snapshot, 4) update banner copy and modal, 5) canary small cohort.

 maria: I'll run queries this afternoon and post results.

 deploy-bot: deploy completed: patch/console-banners v2 -> prod @ 1764321055

 zane: I'll update modal copy and add retry CTA.

 ira: I'll draft alert `compat-routing-quota-mismatch` with threshold and playbook steps.

 maria: Thanks team :thumbsup: Let's sync 15m after I post results.
